subject: general
question: Which of the following best reflects a distinct cultural feature of the Festival of Salhesh?

options.text: Harvest ceremonies involving animal sacrifice by elders in Mithila
Dramatic retelling of Salhesh legends by a Bhagat and Manarias
Buddhist chants invoking Salhesh for monsoon rains
Sword dances performed by women warriors in tribal hill regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dramatic retelling of Salhesh legends by a Bhagat and Manarias**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 

• The **Festival of Salhesh** is a significant cultural event celebrated primarily by the **Dalit communities in Mithila**, a region spanning parts of Bihar and Nepal. 

• The festival is centered around the worship and celebration of **Salhesh**, a folk hero and deity revered for his bravery and justice. 

• A distinct feature of this festival is the **dramatic retelling of Salhesh legends**, performed by a **Bhagat** (folk storyteller or bard) and the **Manarias** (a group of performers who enact the tales). 

• These performances typically include **musical narratives, dance, and theatrics** to bring the stories of Salhesh to life, making them a vibrant cultural express
